expected_output.reasoning:
The agent's response comprehensively satisfies the expected output criteria. It names every trail (IsengardTrail-DO-NOT-DELETE, JMERWIN_Org_Trail organization trail, nebula-data-events-trail, nebula-single-region-trail) with management event logging status, data event types, and logging state. It states management events are captured in every enabled Region via IsengardTrail-DO-NOT-DELETE and that global service events are captured, naming the trail (T1, T2 checks). It individually lists every S3 bucket, Lambda function, and DynamoDB table inventoried, with nebula-audit-covered-012345678901_1 attributed to nebula-data-events-trail as 'Covered', and all other resources marked 'CoveredByOrgTrail-Unverified' rather than definitively covered or uncovered — matching the expected explicit unverified state. The organization trail is reported as attempted with its full ARN ([redacted ARN]) and blocked by the agent's tool (ToolingFailure, not AccessDenied), with explicit commands given for GetEventSelectors/GetTrailStatus to run from CLI or management account. Delivery health is stated per trail with LatestDeliveryTime, LatestDeliveryError fields (L1-L3 checks). Log file validation off on nebula-single-region-trail (and nebula-data-events-trail) is listed as finding L4 with operator change to enable it. Event history's 90-day, management-only, one-region-per-search limitation is explained in 'What Auditors Should Know'. Service-linked role/automated system attribution via userIdentity.invokedBy and sessionIssuer is also explained. Nothing was created/modified/deleted (explicitly stated 'Nothing here was executed'), and the response does not end with an offer to make changes - it ends with a Not Assessed table of items that couldn't be checked. All major expected elements are present and substantively correct.</reasoning>
